text: Teardrop Crimson Spinel can be crafted using Jewelcrafting (375); taught by Design: Teardrop Crimson Spinel and Design: Teardrop Crimson Spinel#Shattered Sun Offensive. A BoP version is also an available quest reward from Hard to Kill, the attunement for heroic Magisters' Terrace.
__NOTOC__ Tel'Abim Bananas are fruits from the island known as Tel'Abim in the southwest of the Maelstrom and far off the eastern coast of Kalimdor.

The Tears of the Goddess are obtained from Tyrande Whisperwind in the night elf encampment of Hyjal Summit and is reusable. It has a 10 second cooldown and persists as long as you don't leave the instance. It will not disappear if you run back from the graveyard. Use this item on your descent after being affected by Archimonde's Air Burst ability - the effect only lasts 3 seconds, so don't use it early.

__NOTOC__ Technician Halmaha is a draenei engineering vendor located next to the inn on the Aldor Rise of Shattrath City, he offers no special supplies. He will also repair the mailbox that he stands next to when it malfunctions.

Technical support, commonly known as "tech support", is the segment of Blizzard responsible for technical issues in their games and cases are usually handled on a game-specific basis. They can be contacted in US and Oceanic through the following methods: [http://www.blizzard.com/support/article.xml?articleId=21424] Please Contact Blizzard using the information below if you're having trouble with your account. ;Phone Support :1-949-955-1382 :Speak to a live representative 8AM to 8PM Pacific Time, Mon-Fri, except US holidays ;E-mail :support@blizzard.com :Mac users can contact our Mac specialists at: macsupport@blizzard.com
Technique: Rituals of the New Moon teaches you how to inscribe .

__NOTOC__ Tekton is a mechanical sheep that can be found at Agee Tyler's farm in the northern mountains of Elwynn Forest, near the source of the Northshire River. Tekton explodes on death, which kills any nearby Docile Sheep and can cause knockback. If a player is close enough to Tekton's explosion, it may even cause them to fall off the hill to their death.
__NOTOC__ Technician Mihila is a draenei engineering trainer and vendor located on Aldor Rise in Shattrath City.

Team 3 is one of Blizzard Entertainment development teams that was responsible for the development of Diablo III. A few members of Team 3 are from Blizzard North, though many had played the previous installments before beginning work on Diablo III. As of November 2018, it consisted of between 100–300 individuals. The team who worked on Diablo III has since been renamed Diablo Legacy and is in charge of legacy Diablo games, under the leadership of Rod Fergusson alongside the Diablo Immortal and Diablo IV teams.
Tega Skyblade is the flight master located at Durotan's Grasp in the contested territory of Talador.

Tel'anor is a massive graveyard and ritual site overlooking Suramar City. Sitting atop a plateau in central Suramar, Tel'anor serves as the final resting place for many famous night elves, some having lived over 10,000 years ago. The site is sacred to the elves of Suramar, who often pay tribute to their ancestors buried in the cemetery. In recent times, Tel'anor has become infested with harpies and withered nightborne, making the area hazardous to visitors. Individuals such as Thaedris Feathersong have made efforts to clean up the area, while others have continued to honor the dead there even during the turbulent Nightfallen rebellion.

Technicians (or techs) are engineers that deal with building, tuning, testing, and fixing, as well as improving. After the initial retaking of Gnomeregan, Gelbin Mekkatorque deployed technicians to work on its broken ventilation to keep the mechanical city smelling fresh and clean. During the Fourth War, the Alliance and Horde deployed several well-known technicians during their campaigns.
Technique: Glyph of the Humble Flyer is given by the following after engaging in a conversation: * in Tiragarde Sound * in Zuldazar
__NOTOC__ Tech-Scavengers are goblins, ogres, and gnolls located on Mechagon Island.
Team Aquashock is a pet battle achievement earned by completing all of the Nazjatar and Mechagon Island pet battle achievements listed below.
Tek'ris is an aqir boss located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. It is part of the Hivemind encounter.
Tectonic Azerite is an Azerite elemental located in Island Expeditions.
Tectonic Storm is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Technique of the Rushing Tiger is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Tear of Morning is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Morning's Tear.
Technique: Glyph of the Shath'Yar is contained in Vault of the Black Empire in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Technique: Darkmoon Card of War is sold by Collector Kojo for .
Technique: Glyph of the Forest Path is sold by Lorelae Wintersong in Moonglade for .
Technique: Songs of the Alliance was never made available. The recipe is instead taught by Catarina Stanford in Stormwind City.
Technique: Glyph of Crackling Flames was never made available. The recipe is instead taught directly as a quest reward from Runes of Power.
Technique: Glyph of Fel Touched Souls was never made available. The recipe is instead taught directly as a quest reward from The Price of Power.
Technique: Mass Mill Gorgrond Flytrap is sold by Nicholas Mitrik in Frostwall and Samantha Scarlet in Lunarfall for .
Technique: Darkmoon Card of Draenor is sold by the following vendors for : *Urgra in Frostwall *Eric Broadoak in Lunarfall *Joao Calhandro in Stormshield *Maru'sa in Warspear

The Temple of Atal'Hakkar (also known as the Sunken Temple) is a shrine to the nefarious Blood God Hakkar the Soulflayer that was erected by the Atal'ai trolls led by their master Jammal'an the Prophet. Believing that this was the intended site for Hakkar's reentry into Azeroth, the great Dragon Aspect Ysera and her green dragonflight sunk the temple into the depths of the Swamp of Sorrows. However, this actually helped the Atal'ai by ensuring their efforts to summon Hakkar went on undisturbed.
in Booty Bay, a Horde-only transport to Gnomeregan.]] Teleportation Pads (also called Transporters) are transportation devices in World of Warcraft.

__NOTOC__ Telonis is a night elf artisan leatherworking trainer located in the Craftsmen's Terrace in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, he was caught in the chaos and the player could save him. However, it was Daniss Ghostdancer who saved him from the fire. After the War of the Thorns, he relocated to the Lion's Rest in Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Telurinon Moonshadow is a night elf herbalism trainer located in Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands.

.]] Templar (sometimes pluralized as templars) are a type of paladin and priest combatants. They are not only the most skilled in battle, but also the most righteous in their demeanor. Strength of arms and purity of mind are strict requirements. In the Order of the Silver Hand, they act as officers. They are also present in the ranks of the Kor'kron, the Scarlet Crusade, and the Argent Dawn where some of them fought in the first battle for the Light's Hope Chapel. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, templar of various races were trained from Silver Hand knights and recruited into the Silver Hand by Commander Born.

Tempered Bracers are a quest reward from Reclaiming the Charred Vale (2) which starts with Keeper Albagorm at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains.

This questing guide for the zone of Teldrassil details the best method to obtain and complete quests in Teldrassil. For a list of all Teldrassil quests in table format (arranged by level), see Teldrassil quests Note: This guide is not meant for power-leveling purposes. Rather, it is meant to show a player the most efficient way to complete all quests available for a particular zone. If you know of a better order or method to accomplish this, your input is welcome (in fact, greatly desired). For major changes, feel free to edit, but make a note in the talk page as to your reasoning.

Tempest-Forge Peacekeepers are elite arcane constructs assembled by the blood elves of Tempest Keep under Kael'thas. The Peacekeepers in particular are found within the Botanica satellite of the Keep. From within their arcane cores, the peacekeepers can unleash powerful bursts of concussive arcane energy to damage and knock back attackers.

The Temple of Bethekk is a subregion of Zul'Gurub, accessed by going to the north of the jungle troll city. It has 4 underground levels, being the lowermost one the place where High Priestess Arlokk and her feline minions were once fought. Now High Priestess Kilnara has taken her place. The temple was created for the panther loa Bethekk, who was trapped here against her will by her followers during the resurrection of Hakkar the Soulflayer.
__NOTOC__ Teldrassil Pink Elekks are see-through pink elekks found in Darnassus and Shattrath City during Brewfest. They can only be seen when you are drunk.

An item collection. This is not a true set. There are no bonuses if you wear more than one or all of this set. This collection of items shares the theme of having Strength, Stamina, and Defense, making it highly useful for plate tanking classes.
Templar's Verdict is an instant Retribution paladin melee attack that consumes 3 Holy Power.

Telluric Currents is a shaman talent in the Restoration tree that restores mana when you deal damage with Lightning Bolt. Since the mana return is based on the damage done by the Lightning Bolt, the talent returns more mana as the shaman's spell power improves, making it much better at very high gear levels. At current endgame gear levels, the talent will return roughly twice the cost of Lightning Bolt.
The Teleport Beacon is provided as an objective for See to the Survivors.

__NOTOC__ Telarius Voidstrider is a night elf demon hunter located underground in the Bashal'Aran Collapse. Although he is not marked as an undead, he is in fact a ghost, having been slain during a confrontation with the warden Maiev Shadowsong many years before the Shattering.

Telaron Windflight is a night elf quest giver located at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas. He is the first person Alliance adventurers are sent to on their questing experience in that zone. His quests involve combating the Emerald Nightmare and the corruption it has caused. During Thrall's journey to the Dreamer's Rest, it is said that Telaron is a leader of this camp and he allowed Thrall to help the local druids against raging elements.
Teldorae the stable master at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains.
Temple Swiftstalkers are tol'vir mobs inside the Halls of Origination. Because of their annoying and dangerous ranged abilities, they are best suited CC'ed and killed last.
Temple Runecasters are tol'vir mobs inside the Halls of Origination. Their healing ability makes them an interrupt priority.
Tel'anor Mementos drop from the following mobs in Suramar: *Tanzanite Borer *Tanzanite Shatterer *Tanzanite Skitterer
__NOTOC__ Temple Priestesses are night elves located in the Temple of Elune of Val'sharah. Some of them are tending to the Druids of the Moon.
Tempest's Wake is a destroyer located at the Lunarfall Shipyard in or at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
Tell Me A Tale is awarded for completing all twenty island expedition quests started by items found during the expedition.

The Temple of Akunda is a temple in the far southeastern corner of Vol'dun dedicated to the thunder lizard loa Akunda. The temple welcomes Zandalari exiles who seek sanctuary from the dangers of Vol'dun. Through a sacred ritual, Akunda enters the minds of his followers and removes the memories that cause them pain. His followers then all rename themselves Akunda and start a new life at the temple. Immediately northwest of the temple lies the Eternal Spring. Akunda's power over storms allows the spring to never run empty, ensuring that his followers never know thirst. Redrock Mesa stretches north of the temple toward the Valley of Sorrows, where Akunda stores the unwanted painful memories he
The Teleport Pad can be found at the entrance of the Chamber of Heart. It is used for The Speaker's Imperative.
A telemancer is a mage specialized in teleportation, aka Portal (spell) spells. They practice telemancy. The nightborne of Suramar seem fond of telemancy.

Tempered Plating drops from the following mobs on Mechagon Island: *Anodized Coilbearer *Anodized Crawler *Anodized Enforcer *Anodized Machinist *Anodized Sentry *Anodized Troubleshooter *Corroded Coilbearer *Corroded Crawler *Corroded Enforcer *Corroded Machinist *Corroded Sentry *Corroded Troubleshooter *Enforcer KX-T57
Temper Tantrum is a dungeon & raids achievement earned by defeating Drest'agath in Ny'alotha, the Waking City after triggering Throes of Agony twice within 60 seconds.

__NOTOC__ Master Telmius Dreamseeker was a blood elf loremaster. He fled the devastation of Quel'Thalas and ended up in the ruins of Eldre'Thalas, now known as Dire Maul. He was incinerated by Prince Tortheldrin while trying to gain knowledge from the Shen'dralar ancients found within. His librams indicate that he ventured to Kalimdor sometime after Prince Kael'thas pledged his allegiance to Illidan Stormrage. They make reference to both Kael and Illidan, praising both and thus making clear whom he serves.
Tempest of the Lightbringer is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Lightbringer's Tempest.
__NOTOC__ The Template Archive is located in a chamber in the Nexus of Actualization in Zereth Mortis. The chamber is blocked by an Orb. Once the archive has been looted, a Teleporter leads outside.
__NOTOC__ Teleporter Locks are found inside and outside the Catalyst Wards in Zereth Mortis. They are involved in the process to obtain the Undulating Foliage.

The Tempest Unleashed is the pre- launch event. The Primalists invaded Azeroth before the launch of the expansion starting on November 15, rewarding players that stood against them with unique rewards. The start of the event also coincided with the release of dracthyr evoker, and their starting zone the Forbidden Reach, as well as the Uldaman: Legacy of Tyr dungeon. The event has invasions in three separate locations, split between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms - Northern Barrens, Un'Goro Crater, and the Badlands. The launch event, along with the Dragonflight introduction questline, are available to level 10 characters in the pre-patch.

Tempest Cove is the body of water north of Morqut Islet, west of the Tempest Coast of the Caldera of the Menders, south of the Winglord's Perch, and east of the Sylvern's Roost off the western shore of Forbidden Reach. The cove is dominated by a fleet of Irontide Raiders pirate ships. In an underwater cave, the rare hydra Gahz'raxes spawns. Occasionally the Forbidden Hoard spawns at on a small island guarded by four Irontide Swoopers.

The Tempest Coast lies between the Tempest Cove and the Caldera of the Menders in western Forbidden Reach. The area is also bordered to the southeast by the Aerie Chasm. The coast has been overrun by the Irontide Raiders, pushing inland from the fleet of pirate ships in the cove. There's also a small cave mouth at that is both not marked on the map and only reachable by flight, full of slyvern.
Templar Strikes is a Retribution paladin talent that replaces Crusader Strike with the Templar Strike and Templar Slash abilities. It is an exclusive choice node with Crusading Strikes.
Templar Strike is an ability granted by the Templar Strikes talent. It turns into Templar Slash after use.
Templar Slash is an ability granted by the Templar Strikes talent. It activates after using Templar Strike.
Teleport Scroll: Menethil Harbor is a quest reward from Talented.
Teleport Scroll: Orgrimmar Zeppelin Tower is a quest reward from Talented.
Teleport Scroll: Stormwind Harbor is a quest reward from Talented.
__NOTOC__ Teremus the Devourer is a massive rare black drake that can be found flying around the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands.

Terokkar Forest (pronounced "TEH-row-kawr"), once known as Talador and the Spires of Arak, is a zone in Outland located east of Nagrand, west of Shadowmoon Valley, southeast of Zangarmarsh, and southwest of Hellfire Peninsula. This forest was most likely named after Terokk, the greatest king in arakkoa history. Formerly it was known as Talador. Terokkar was seen as the Bone Wastes in previous maps and lore sources, but the Bone Wastes themselves are now a sub-region within the Terokkar Forest zone.
Tepa is a tauren tailoring trainer located in the Thunder Bluff Armorers building on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.
__NOTOC__ Teronis' Corpse is a night elf quest giver located on the island in Lake Falathim in Ashenvale. Teronis was killed by tendrils spawned by Harbinger Aphotic while searching for Dartol's Rod.
.]] Temporus is the second mini-boss of Opening the Dark Portal in Caverns of Time. He is a drake of the Infinite dragonflight that spawns upon the opening of the 12th portal.

The Temple of Zin-Malor is an ancient building situated in the Ruins of Eldarath. It was once a prominent night elven temple to the worship of their goddess, Elune. Its similarity to the nearby Temple of Arkkoran is striking, as they both have a very similar design to the current Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. The temple is currently occupied by the Spitelash tribe of naga under the leadership of Warlord Krellian, who himself inhabits the temple in a place of honor. The Crystal of Zin-Malor once rested here but was stolen by the inhabitants of Kel'Theril in Winterspring. The temple has at least one underground royal vault, which contains a chest of pandaren design, the last gift the pandar
Terokk's Downfall is the final quest in a long quest chain to destroy Terokk, the god of Skettis.

The Temple of Life is situated in the center of the Plain of Echoes, just to the north of Camp Tunka'lo, in the northeast reaches of Storm Peaks. This temple was the post of Keeper Freya until Loken started his rebellion against the other titanic watchers. Today, she is absent. It is said that evidence indicates a significant battle and that the opponent of Watcher Freya was estimated to be of similar size and strength to Watcher Freya (presumably Loken himself, though there is no clear indication of who Freya's opponent is/was). Temple guardians are no longer present and plant forms associated with the temple are deceased. Freya can be found as a boss in Ulduar.

The Temple of Invention is a titan temple located in the western part of the Terrace of the Makers, in the northern region of the Storm Peaks. It is Keeper Mimiron's seat of power, though rather than a throne, it's got some sort of titan machine in its center. The mechagnome guardians here have been corrupted by an unknown source.
Tendon Rip is one of the pet abilities that only aqiri can use.

:Think of a cross between a boar and a stag, and you've got yourself a shoveltusk. This steak is beloved by magic users, who claim it gives them just a little bit of an edge in casting their spells. Don't ask us how. Tender Shoveltusk Steak is created by Northrend Cooking (25); taught by Recipe: Tender Shoveltusk Steak.

Tense Eye of Zul is a socketed gem crafted by Jewelcrafting. It requires a minimum skill of 450 and a Simple Grinder. ; Materials required: :1x Eye of Zul The recipe taught by Design: Tense Eye of Zul, sold by Timothy Jones in Dalaran, and Inessera in Shattrath City for 4 Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Tokens.

Tempus Wyrms are elite bronze drakes found fighting the infinite dragonflight across time in the Bronze Dragonshrine in Dragonblight.

The Temple of the Jade Serpent (or the Jade Temple, the Jade Serpent Temple, and the East Temple) is a pandaren temple in the Jade Forest. It is guarded by the Order of the Cloud Serpent. It is a level 85-86 5-man dungeon. It was introduced with the launch of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. There is a level-90 heroic and a retired Level 90 Season 1 Challenge Mode version available. The dungeon is also avaliable in mythic and mythic+ difficulties for season one of Dragonflight.

Temple of Kotmogu is a 10vs10 resource race battleground, introduced in Mists of Pandaria. Located in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms, the objective of the battleground is to hold orbs of power for as long as possible, accumulating points but taking (and dealing) more damage the longer you hold it.
The Terrace of the Augurs is a subzone of the Lost City of Tol'vir.

The Terrace of Endless Spring (or the Terrace of Eternal Spring) is one of the three launch raids of World of Warcraft: Mists of Pandaria. It allows players to finally defeat the Sha of Fear, a "super super huge raid boss" who "has turned other local creatures into Sha", after driving it out of the Heart of Fear. The raid is relatively small with four boss encounters: the Protectors of the Endless, a trio of Jinyu; Tsulong, a cloud serpent; Lei Shi, a water spirit; and the Sha of Fear itself as the final boss. The raid is located at the midpoint of the Veiled Stair, a mountain pass between the northeastern corner of the Valley of the Four Winds and the southern part of the Kun-Lai Summit. Th

Tenwu of the Red Smoke is a pandaren rogue of the Shado-Pan, who can assist the players with Shado-Pan daily quests after completing the quest The Challenger's Ring: Tenwu of the Red Smoke in Townlong Steppes. Similar in ways to Ren Firetongue, Tenwu is eccentric and highly proud of his own looks and abilities. He can be seen during the Siege of Niuzao Temple. He later joins with the other elite Shado-pan to assault the Isle of Thunder where he is the objective in Troves of the Thunder King. Tenwu can be seen with Snow Blossom in the Timeless Isle overlooking the Celestial Court.
Tenok is a rare raptor located inside a small cave at Dagger Pass in Stonetalon Mountains.

Terokkar Pass is the mountain pass that runs from the Spires of Arak north into Talador. A number of Arakkoa Outcasts are seen fleeing up through the pass to Talador, escaping the genocidal wrath of the airborne Adherents of Rukhmar.

.]] Teroclaws are a type of large predatory birds mainly found in the forests of Talador on . They use their strong beaks to sever both flesh and bone and are the rulers of Talador's skies, rather than the rylaks found in many of Draenor's other locales. They are potent hunters of the small and furry. The teroclaw Kil'uun has taken to flying near the Horde outpost Vol'jin's Pride and has been described as having crazy in its eyes. Cloudfeathers are teroclaws found in the Shadowlands but there also exists teroclaws that are named as such in Ardenweald.

The Temple of Sha'naar was a draenei temple and surrounding village, in Tanaan Jungle, that got destroyed by the Sargerei. The Legion worshipers replaced the village with training grounds, demon summoning, and are now corrupting the wildlife into fel weapons. Some of the survivors fled to the Sha'naari Refuge.

Temple of a Thousand Lights is a large temple dedicated to Queen Azshara found south of Shackle's Den in southeastern Azsuna. The exemplars here remain as ghosts like the Court of Farondis, but cry out their continued loyalty to the Queen that killed them while she was striking at Prince Farondis. They are mages that summon powerful elementals, including the world boss Calamir (before it was moved to the Isle of the Watchers). Perhaps symbolically, it towers over the Garden of Elune. It was taken over by the Dread Fleet for a time, and also serves as the Legion's main base during the assault on Azsuna.

Terrace of the Watchers was a terrace used by Yotnar and the other watchers in Stormheim. Aggramar's Vault is found under and in front of here. The Felskorn have begun destroying the area to prevent others from gaining knowledge about the Aegis of Aggramar.
Tentacle Slap is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

The Temple of Fal'adora is an underground temple of Elune located in the town ruins of Falanaar within the region of Suramar. Part of the entrance plaza has collapsed into a section of the Arcway known as the Falanaar Tunnels, and a tunnel to the Shattered Locus can be found inside. The temple is one of the three entrances to the tunnels, and the 'main' one that Withered Army Training starts at.
Tendrils of Uul are tentacles summoned by the Shadow of the Darkness in Highmountain.

__NOTOC__ The Temple of Kimbul is a ruined temple on the northern tip of Vol'dun dedicated to the loa Eraka no Kimbul. The Bouldered Bluffs lie just to the west, while to the east, the ruined and spider-infested Terrace of the Fang stretches down toward the Shrouded Shore. Centuries ago, the temple was attacked by an army of naga led by Summoner Mepjila. Kimbul arrived too late to save his Zandalari worshippers from death, and just as he killed Mepjila, she cursed the souls of his followers to unending torment. Now the temple lies abandoned and broken, its entrance sealed by a magical barrier that will only open to whoever holds the :Ring of Tides. Seeking refuge from the Stormcoil naga, the

__NOTOC__ The Temple of Rezan is the temple dedicated to the loa Rezan in eastern Zuldazar. The golden statues - Rezan the Hunter, Rezan the Conqueror, and Rezan the King - are a source of strength to the loa. It is attacked by the Atal'zul cultists and the Kao-Tien mogu, led by Vilnak'dor, in an effort to sacrifice the loa.

Terrace of the Speakers is a location in Dazar'alor, Zuldazar where the members of the lesser tribes are located. The tribes represented include: *Bloodscalp tribe *Drakkari tribe *Firetree tribe *Frostmane tribe *Revantusk tribe *Shadowtooth clan *Shatterspear tribe *Skullsplitter tribe *Smolderthorn tribe *Mossflayer tribe *Vilebranch tribe *Winterax tribe *Witherbark tribe
The Tenacity of Cursed Blood is a quest reward from Ending the New Beginning.
The Terrace of Desolation forms the topmost part of the Hive in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. Ra-den the Despoiled is located here.
Tentacles of Drest'agath are tentacles located in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
Ten of Towers is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Temple of Humility is located in eastern Bastion. It is overseen by Paragon Chyrus and his Hand Voitha. It's power is essential in ascending new kyrians through the Crest of Ascension. It has an important collection of teachings for the kyrians. Projections of Ancient Instructors in soul mirrors are generated to teach and instruct kyrians as well.
Temporal Warp is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Temporal Warp.

The Terrace of Clear Thought is the top level of the interior of the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle. The Dawning Span, which connects the temple to the Ridge of Laughing Winds, connects into this chamber. While the chamber existed in the Mists of Pandaria version of the Wandering Isle, it was made its own subzone as part of the monks' Class Hall in Legion; in the class hall version, it is accessed by a Teleportation Mandala in the Hall of the Seasons, located to the left as one looks at the statue of Liu Lang and Shen-zin Su. Lao Li the Quiet can be found here.
__NOTOC__ Temporal Dragonhead is a common fish and cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking. It can only be caught in the Thaldraszus zone.

The Temporal Conflux in southeastern Thaldraszus is the location where the bronze dragonflight centralize their watch over the timeways. It guards the Bronze Temple, which, in patch 10.1.5, leads to the Dawn of the Infinite megadungeon.
__NOTOC__ Tenmod is a mountain giant located in Azure Span during Grand Hunts.

Temporal Gossamer is provided to friendly players who are deputized by the Ancient Memories of an evoker attempting to create Nasz'uro, the Unbound Legacy. The item starts the Temporal Gossamer quest, which eventually rewards an Empowered Temporal Gossamer that massively buffs the drop rate of Temporal Vestigial needed for It Takes a Village to Make an Artifact.

Temporal Vestigial is an ingredient to make Nasz'uro, the Unbound Legacy, the evoker legendary. Vestigals drop from Fyrakk Assaults named elites and Aberrus, the Shadowed Crucible bosses for players on the quest It Takes a Village to Make an Artifact. Four hundred are then used as reagents to craft the Reclaimed Gauntlet Chassis, Inspired Order Recalibrator, and Immaculate Coalescing Dracothyst for the same quest. The Ancient Memories-holding evoker can deputize other players to help them gather faster. Said players will be given the Temporal Gossamer quest, which rewards the Empowered Temporal Gossamer, massively increasing the drop rate of vestigals for the evoker in question.
Thaddeus Webb is a Forsaken enchanting vendor located in the Apothecarium in the Undercity.

Terror Run is an area just west of the Slithering Scar in southwestern Un'Goro Crater. This is the only area where Red Power Crystals can be found. During the Primalists' attack, the area was invaded by elementals. Their presence imbued the beasts in the area.
Thalon is a tauren flight master located at Shadowprey Village in Desolace. He can be found at the end of the dock.

Thal'trak Proudtusk is a jungle troll quest giver that used to be located in Kargath in the Badlands. Kargath was destroyed in the Cataclysm and he has since been relocated to the inside entrance of Blackrock Depths. His wife was Sha'ni Proudtusk who he planned to live in the Hinterlands with, before she died. After he was informed of his wife's death, Thal'trak became distraught and couldn't bear to be in possession of his love's ring. For in his own words "The ring means nothing to me now. Not without her..."

The Thalassian Pass is the passage through the mountains south from Quel'Thalas to the Eastern Plaguelands, and is located in the far southern Ghostlands. The large gatehouse near the portal is believed to be one of the elfgates gates that sealed off Quel'Thalas from Lordaeron. The gates are flanked by Scourge banners — possibly placed when the Scourge snuck through Quel'Thalas' defenses, aided by the traitor Dar'Khan Drathir.

The Terrestrial Watchtower is an area within the Halls of Lightning that houses displays of multiple planets including Azeroth. At the end of the room is Loken, the final boss of the Halls of Lightning, seated on his throne awaiting players to arrive. When Loken is killed, he says "My death... heralds the end of this world", and the display of Azeroth lights on fire.

A Terrain marker is an object used to mark a location on the terrain. Generally, it is placed by using an item to spawn the object, but could be placed by a spell or an ability. Any placeable object can mark terrain, but in order to be useful the marking object must be: *Visible over a distance - in WoW, that generally means a large object ** If subtlety is warranted, a small object may server better *Persistent - no fixed duration, but generally at least tens of seconds or several minutes *Stays in a fixed location - if it wanders, it can't mark a spot on the map __NOTOC__

The Thalo'dan Privateers are a group of privateers led by Captain Thalo'thas Brightsun. They have lost numerous ships to the overzealous and paranoid humans of Northwatch Hold. The most recent sinking was a transport carrying moonshine between Booty Bay and Ratchet, where one survivor, Gilthares Firebough, was captured and was being held as an enemy and threat to the Alliance. After the Cataclysm, they were still having problems with Northwatch Hold, who kept sinking the privateer ships.

Thal'darah Guardians are the guards at Thal'darah Overlook in Stonetalon Mountains. They appear to be druids in bear form. Two of them stand watch by . Along with the storyline in this area, this strongly suggests they are his students, many of whom can be found fleeing in terror in Thal'darah Grove below, searching for their master.
Thalassian Range is the southeastern mountain range in the Ghostlands, around and south of Zul'Aman.
Terrifying Roar was a Hunter Pet ability, specific to Devilsaurs. It increases the critical strike chance of the hunter's party and raid members by 5% for 1 minute.

__NOTOC__ Terran "Justice" Gregory is a human paladin located in Stormwind City's Cathedral Square. He can be found kneeling in front of the statue of Uther the Lightbringer in the center of the square, with Deva Marie standing next to him.

Thaegra Tillstone is the innkeeper of the Golden Keg, the inn located in the Dwarven District of Stormwind City.

Thalen Songweaver is a blood elf archmage of some repute, once part of the Sunreavers and thus the Kirin Tor. In truth, however, Thalen was a spy for Garrosh Hellscream, Warchief of the Horde, for whom he created the mana bomb used to destroy Theramore. Songweaver's demeanor is generally prideful, jovial, and narcissistic. Songweaver sees his actions as simply being loyal to the Horde, with the persecution of Garrosh and his forces being unfair. He aided Kairozdormu's plot to save Garrosh from Pandaria.
Thal'darah's Hippogryph Whistle is provided as an objective for Save the Children! (Stonetalon Mountains).

Tesska the Broken can be found in one of the Arakkoa Outcasts camps. Tesska is the only one alive in the camp, and he appears to be casting some sinister spell on one of the corpses. When engaged, Tesska will spout a set of dark magical wings. The first time killed, Tesska will drop Tesska's Cursed Talisman along with some Garrison Resources.
Thal'kiel's Consumption is a Demonology warlock ability, learned from Skull of the Man'ari.

Terrors of the Shore is an achievement earned from defeating the 4 world bosses on the Broken Shore. These world bosses only spawn when the Nether Disruptor is active, and only one boss is active and remains the same until the Disruptor is destroyed, even if it carries over into the next week.
Thal'kiel's Lingering Power is a Demonology warlock artifact trait. It requires all other base traits to be purchased.
Terrify is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
Terrified Civilians are humans located in Crosswind Commons in Boralus during Albatrocity.
thalas is a Thalassian suffix meaning "home" for calling a city or a country: *Nar'thalas *Eldre'thalas *Quel'Thalas

Terrified Yaks are yaks located in Kun-Lai Summit. They are being chased and ridden by Burilgi Despoilers. After the yaungol is attacked, the yak briefly turns and runs away. Some are also found dead.

The Thaldraszus storyline concludes the level-up portion of the Dragonflight campaign. Additional questlines continue as part of the Friend of the Dragon Isles major faction campaigns.

Thane Korth'azz is one of the Four Horsemen of Naxxramas. He holds the power of flame, being even able to call forth fiery meteors from the skies. Korth'azz is a fallen dwarf paladin. There is speculation that he fell to the Scourge after Uther's death, as he might have been a leading member of the Knights of the Silver Hand. This is at least partially confirmed when Alexandros Mograine refers to Korth'azz as "one of Uther's men". Korth'azz likely represents the "Pale Rider of Death", based on his light green color scheme.

Tharl Stonebleeder is a level 35 small pet keeper located in the Valley of Honor in the orcish city of Orgrimmar. People who attended BlizzCon and received a card with a code on it could give their code to Tharl or his companion Zas'Tysh to receive the Baby Murloc. Zas'Tysh now stands without Tharl, who was strangely underwater in the nearby pond until it was fixed in patch 4.0.6.

He is responsible for some of the attacks on Lakeshire. Recently, Marshal Marris of Lakeshire has enlisted the help of Alliance adventurers to hunt down and kill this dangerous orc. In Cataclysm, he becomes a death knight. Colonel Troteman sends Bravo Company to kill him and Gath'Ilzogg.

Thandol is the third and final mission of the Horde campaign in Warcraft II: Tides of Darkness Shareware. This is an early version of the mission Assault on Hillsbrad as seen in the retail game. It shares similar mission objectives, but the map design and mission briefing are different: in the retail game the Horde chooses to attack the kingdom of Lordaeron through the island of Zul'Dare rather than through Khaz Modan. In the retail game the Horde does not turn towards Khaz Modan until the second act.
__NOTOC__ Thargold Ironwing is a dwarf located in Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City. He will offer Alliance players a free and purely scenic gryphon ride around the harbor.

Tharon'ja is a Drakkari wind serpent loa, trusted guardian of Drak'Tharon Keep and the patron of those who defended the borders of Zul'Drak until his own followers turned on him, due to the threat of the Scourge and lies of the Lich King. His own Prophet killed him in Drak'Tharon Keep and claimed his power, driving the loa off to the spirit world. Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter summoned Tharon'ja's spirit in order to communicate with him at the Za'Tual boneyard, between Za'Tual and the Ihgaluk Crag on the southeastern coast of the Isle of Thunder. Tharon'ja's spirit is found recovering in a wildseed in the Tranquil Pools of Ardenweald.

Thane Illskar is a ruthless vrykul mage that can be found in the Circle of Suffering in the Underhalls of Icecrown. He has two champions who faithfully serve him: Volgur, a warrior and Brita, a hunter. He cheated to become the Thane, using dark magic to weaken Bethod Feigr before the battle.

The Black Anvil is a large anvil in the center of Shadowforge City in Blackrock Depths. Guarded by Lord Incendius, this anvil is required to craft all Dark Iron items. It is made up of only the purest Dark iron, smelted and refined with secrets only revealed to the Dark Iron clan's most trusted miners and blacksmiths. The clan considers the anvil to be sacred, and Dark Iron dwarves may sometimes say "May the Black Anvil bless ye."

Eight dark iron ore are required to smelt one dark iron bar. The Black Forge is also the only place where one can make the Smoking Heart of the Mountain, an enchanting recipe (requires enchanting 265 to make). The forge is located just before the bridge leading into the main Molten Core entrance and just after the Summoners' Tomb. Having realized how dangerous a reality-warping artifact was, the Lorewalkers took on the burden of keeping the world safe from their creation and the possible consequences.

The Doctor's Key drops from Doctor Maleficus and Doctor Gutrick in Shadowmoon Valley

The Dungeons of Dalaran is chapter 3 of Curse of the Blood Elves. It occurred hours after A Dark Covenant. Prince Kael'thas Sunstrider and his followers had been arrested by the forces of Lord Garithos for allying themselves with the Naga, despite the fact that without their aid, Kael and the blood elves would've been destroyed by Dalvengyr and the Scourge.
The Dragons of Outland is an original English manga written by Richard Knaak and illustrated by Kim Jae-Hwan taking place in the Warcraft universe. The Dragons of Outland is Volume 1 in Shadow Wing.
The Doctor's Strongbox can be found in Shadowmoon Valley.
The Doomstone is a quest item for The Doomstone (quest). One of its properties is the ability to absorb a great deal of energy.
The Elements Cry Out is an optional breadcrumb beginning the Elemental Unrest world event. Earthen Ring Emissaries can be found in any capital city, and Erunak is in front of the bank in Stormwind.

"The Emperor's Burden - Part 1" is part of a series of in-game books called The Emperor's Burden. It can be found at in central Dawn's Blossom. The shrine is on the lower level near the central pond, opposite the flight master. Interacting with The Emperor's Burden - Part 1 is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement The Seven Burdens of Shaohao.
The book The Duel of Thunder and Strength can be found at in the southeast corner of the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

The Dissector is a title granted after killing Rik'kal the Dissector and taking his ability during the Paragons of the Klaxxi fight. It is a part of the Now We are the Paragon achievement. Only DPS can take this title. The title is not permanent, but is granted via a 60-minute buff called Mad Scientist. The title appears after your character's name: :, the Dissector

The Diary of CV - Part III is a book found at high up the mountain in an abandoned camp overlooking Ashvane Foundry in Tiragarde Sound. Also in the camp are a small football, a shovel, a painter's easel, empty canvas, paint brush, and a horde sack and shield. A Glacier Pengling may spawn on top of the book, making it harder to spot from a distance.

The Endless Forest concludes the first chapter of the Night Fae Campaign. Lady Moonberry starts the Torghast interlude with The Highlord Calls, and the next chapter will unlock after reaching Renown (Shadowlands) 5, first achievable the week of December 1, starting with Daughter of the Night Warrior.

"The Embrace" is a short story by Christie Golden published in the anthology Folk & Fairy Tales of Azeroth. It is illustrated by Cory Godbey. The story is an origin myth for the Blue Child, Azeroth's smallest moon, and the rare alignment known as the Embrace.

The Fluffy Bunny is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic - Illusion.
The Fate of Apprentice Argoly is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of The Schools of Arcane Magic.
The Fifth Element is a feat of strength for obtaining an Aqual Quintessence. This becomes available from Duke Hydraxis after completing Hands of the Enemy.

The Firehawk is a Sunreavers destroyer located in the middle of the Sea Reaver's Run just of the northern coast of Icecrown and west of its Silver Covenant companion, The Wavecrest. During the war against the Lich King, Captain Aerthas Firehawk and his crew of Firehawk Mariners, fought off-boarding Kvaldir Harpooners and Kvaldir Berserkers, in addition to attacks from the North Sea Kraken. At some point, they had to slay the kraken they kept summoning, with the help of adventurers. And when they weren't fighting, they were fishing for sharks.
For The Final Voyage of the Brashtide, speak with Kebok in Booty Bay to board a Bold Wind Rider. Then use the handbombs to kill 85 Brashtide Crewmen and destroy 6 Brashtide Attack Boats.
The Fiddler is a cricket located at the Shrine of Seven Stars in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

__NOTOC__ The Eye of Anzu is a powerful orb that was granted to the Talon King by after Terokk had been cast into the cursed pools of Sethekk Hollow. The fallen king thereafter used it as a scrying orb to commune with the Raven God. At some point, the Eye was found by the arakkoa Syth, who stashed it in a ravager den. At some point after the events of the Spires of Arak storyline, Shadow-Sage Iskar claimed the Eye for himself and took it with him to . The orb is used during the fight with Shadow-Lord Iskar to pierce through his illusions.
The Fifth Skull is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
The Final Pop is an ability that would be used during a Pet Battle.

The Great Anvil is an anvil located in the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. It has been in use for unknown centuries. Many weapons and objects of beauty have been crafted upon it, including the Ashbringer, which was made by King Magni Bronzebeard himself. When Magni became mobile again after being turned to diamond four years earlier, the Anvil was the first thing he went to see in his walkabout around the city. The Great Anvil can be used both for blacksmithing and as a forge for smelting. No recipes are exclusive to it. __NOTOC__

The Great Masquerade was the alliance quest chain that leads to obtaining the Drakefire Amulet, the key to Onyxia's Lair. This was one of the most arduous quest chains in the game, involving multiple trips into Blackrock Depths, a major event in Stormwind City, and a raid in Upper Blackrock Spire. It could require Lower Blackrock Spire runs as well, to acquire the key to the raid area.

The Grateful Dead is the one and only quest involved with the world event Day of the Dead. It involves cooking (or being lazy and buying) some Bread of the Dead and offering it to a cheerful spirit in a capital city's graveyard.
The Grey One was a large statue of a petrified drogbar found on an upper ledge in the northeastern part of Neltharion's Vault in Highmountain among piles of treasure.
